# Palsa

```{r}
# Build Palsa adjacency matrices across annual layers (2011-2017)
layer_files <- list(
  "Input/layer1_palsa_unique.csv",
  "Input/layer2_palsa_unique.csv",
  "Input/layer3_palsa_unique.csv",
  "Input/layer4_palsa_unique.csv",
  "Input/layer5_palsa_unique.csv",
  "Input/layer6_palsa_unique.csv",
  "Input/layer7_palsa_unique.csv"
)

edge_lists <- lapply(layer_files, function(file) {
  layer <- read.csv(file, header=FALSE)
  colnames(layer) <- c("source", "target")
  layer$source <- as.character(layer$source)
  layer$target <- as.character(layer$target)
  return(layer)
})

all_nodes <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(edge_lists, function(edge_list) {
  unique(c(edge_list$source, edge_list$target))
}))))
num_nodes <- length(all_nodes)

adjacency_matrices <- lapply(edge_lists, function(edge_list) {
  adj_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow=num_nodes, ncol=num_nodes)
  rownames(adj_matrix) <- all_nodes
  colnames(adj_matrix) <- all_nodes
  for (i in 1:nrow(edge_list)) {
    source <- edge_list$source[i]
    target <- edge_list$target[i]
    adj_matrix[source, target] <- 1
    adj_matrix[target, source] <- 1
  }
  return(adj_matrix)
})

g.list <- lapply(adjacency_matrices, function(adj_matrix) {
  graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_matrix, mode="undirected")
})
```

```{r}
library(ggraph)
library(cowplot)

# Generate 2D multiplex layout plot for Palsa
lay <- layoutMultiplex(g.list, layout="mds", ggplot.format=TRUE, box=FALSE)

layer.colors <- brewer.pal(8, "Set2")

palsa <- plot_multiplex(g.list, layer.colors, node.size.values = "0.1", edge.alpha = 0.1, centrality.measure = "degree", min.size = 0, max.size = 0.1, node.alpha = 0.5, layout = lay, ggplot.format=TRUE, show.legend = FALSE, edge.colors = "black")

```

```{r}
fen <- plot_multiplex(g.list, layer.colors, node.size.values = "0.1", edge.alpha = 0.1, centrality.measure = "degree", min.size = 0, max.size = 0.5, node.alpha = 0.5, layout = lay, ggplot.format=TRUE, show.legend = FALSE, edge.colors = "black")

```

```{r}
library(multinet)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)

# Calculate year-over-year layer degree correlations (Spearman's rho) for Palsa
net_palsa <- read_ml("Input/multinet_network_input_palsa.txt", aligned = TRUE)
temp_palsa <- multinet::layer_comparison_ml(net_palsa, method = "rho.degree")
temp_palsa$Year <- row.names(temp_palsa)
melted_palsa <- melt(temp_palsa)
colnames(melted_palsa) <- c("Year1", "Year2", "value")
melted_palsa$Year1 <- as.character(melted_palsa$Year1)
melted_palsa$Year2 <- as.character(melted_palsa$Year2)
melted_palsa$value <- as.numeric(melted_palsa$value)
df_palsa <- melted_palsa %>% arrange(Year1, Year2)
df_palsa$Year1 <- sub("^X", "", df_palsa$Year1)
df_palsa$Year2 <- sub("^X", "", df_palsa$Year2)
palsa_undup <- subset(df_palsa, Year1 != Year2)

p <- ggboxplot(
  palsa_undup, 
  x = "Year1", 
  y = "value", 
  ylim = c(-0.15, 0.95), 
  ylab = "Degree correlation (ρ)", 
  xlab = "Comparison year",
  outlier.shape = NA,
  width = 0.4
) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.1, 
    aes(x = Year1, y = value), 
    color = "black", 
    size = 2
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(label.y = 0.9, label.x = 1.1, size = 5, label = "p.format") +
  ggtitle("Palsa") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

# Calculate year-over-year layer degree correlations (Spearman's rho) for Bog
net_bog <- read_ml("Input/multinet_network_input_bog.txt", aligned = TRUE)
temp_bog <- multinet::layer_comparison_ml(net_bog, method = "rho.degree")
temp_bog$Year <- row.names(temp_bog)
melted_bog <- melt(temp_bog)
colnames(melted_bog) <- c("Year1", "Year2", "value")
melted_bog$Year1 <- as.character(melted_bog$Year1)
melted_bog$Year2 <- as.character(melted_bog$Year2)
melted_bog$value <- as.numeric(melted_bog$value)
df_bog <- melted_bog %>% arrange(Year1, Year2)
df_bog$Year1 <- sub("^X", "", df_bog$Year1)
df_bog$Year2 <- sub("^X", "", df_bog$Year2)
bog_undup <- subset(df_bog, Year1 != Year2)

b <- ggboxplot(
  bog_undup, 
  x = "Year1", 
  y = "value", 
  ylim = c(-0.15, 0.95), 
  ylab = "Degree correlation (ρ)", 
  xlab = "Comparison year",
  outlier.shape = NA,
  width = 0.4
) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.1, 
    aes(x = Year1, y = value), 
    color = "black", 
    size = 2
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(label.y = 0.9, label.x = 1, size = 5, label = "p.format") +
  ggtitle("Bog") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )

# Calculate year-over-year layer degree correlations (Spearman's rho) for Fen
net_fen <- read_ml("Input/multinet_network_input_fen.txt", aligned = TRUE)
temp_fen <- multinet::layer_comparison_ml(net_fen, method = "rho.degree")
temp_fen$Year <- row.names(temp_fen)
melted_fen <- melt(temp_fen)
colnames(melted_fen) <- c("Year1", "Year2", "value")
melted_fen$Year1 <- as.character(melted_fen$Year1)
melted_fen$Year2 <- as.character(melted_fen$Year2)
melted_fen$value <- as.numeric(melted_fen$value)
df_fen <- melted_fen %>% arrange(Year1, Year2)
df_fen$Year1 <- sub("^X", "", df_fen$Year1)
df_fen$Year2 <- sub("^X", "", df_fen$Year2)
fen_undup <- subset(df_fen, Year1 != Year2)

f <- ggboxplot(
  fen_undup, 
  x = "Year1", 
  y = "value", 
  ylim = c(-0.15, 0.95), 
  ylab = "Degree correlation (ρ)", 
  xlab = "Comparison year",
  outlier.shape = NA,
  width = 0.4
) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.1, 
    aes(x = Year1, y = value), 
    color = "black", 
    size = 2
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(label.y = 0.9, size = 5, label.x = 1, label = "p.format") +
  ggtitle("Fen") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
# Combine network layouts and degree correlation boxplots into multi-panel figure
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid(palsa, p, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(5, 1)),
  plot_grid(bog, b, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(5, 1)),
  plot_grid(fen, f, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(5, 1)),
  nrow = 3,
  rel_heights = c(1, 1, 1.3),
  align = "v",
  axis = "tb"
)

ggsave(combined_plot,
       filename = "Output/network.png",
       width = 20, height = 10, dpi = 600)

ggsave(
  filename = "Output/network.svg",
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 20,
  height = 10,
  units = "in"
)

```
